只记录你实际体验过的内容；未尝试的功能可写“未尝试”。无需运行模型或付费来反馈本地阅读体验。中文、英文均可。
Report only what you actually tried; mark other features as not attempted. Local-reading feedback needs no paid model calls. Chinese or English is welcome.

### 版本与环境 / Version and environment

- EzRead 版本／提交号 / App version or commit:
- Windows 版本与系统架构 / Windows version and architecture:
- 安装版或源码版 / Installer or source:

### 实际尝试的流程 / Workflow actually tried

例如：下载 → 首次启动 → 导入 → 阅读 → 保存笔记 → 关闭重开。请按顺序描述，注明停在哪一步。
For example: download → launch → import → read → save a note → reopen. Describe the steps in order and where you stopped.

### 预期与实际体验 / Expected and actual experience

- 顺利完成的部分 / What worked:
- 阻碍、错误或不清楚的地方 / What failed or was unclear:
- 对应步骤及是否可重复 / Related step and reproducibility:

### 模型调用情况 / Model usage

- [ ] 未尝试模型功能 / No AI features attempted
- [ ] 只配置或尝试调用，未获得成功结果 / Configured or attempted, no successful result
- [ ] 实际 API 调用成功（可注明供应商与模型，无需密钥） / Real API call succeeded (provider/model only)

### 建议或脱敏附件（可选） / Suggestions or redacted attachments, optional

先移除私人论文、对话、账号、个人路径、密钥及 OAuth／授权链接。不要上传整个文献库、私有设置或原始 API 请求／响应。
Remove private papers, conversations, account details, personal paths, keys and authorization links. Do not upload a whole library, private settings or raw API traffic.
